title: Problem
问题
html:
Whole-image instruction tuning cannot reliably connect a phrase in dialogue to a precise object region, while box-only systems often lack open-ended conversation targets.

The paper's decision boundary is the released Groma Instruct training object, not a model-only report or an evaluation-only benchmark. One record contains image, region tokens or boxes, grounded user dialogue, and assistant response; its selection boundary is region-box consistency, source annotations, and grounding benchmark scores, and the records are consumed by grounded multimodal instruction SFT.

L4 facts: the official ECCV 2024 page, public records at https://huggingface.co/datasets/FoundationVision/groma_instruct, release scale and terms were checked on 2026-07-27. The paper is included because its central contribution directly constructs or curates serialized post-training targets.

整图指令微调难以把对话短语稳定连接到精确区域，而只使用框坐标的系统又缺少开放式会话目标。

Groma 把选定区域表示为局部视觉 token，再围绕这些 token 生成多轮识别、描述和定位对话，用统一记录训练模型。 该方法直接产出 Groma Instruct。本卡的决策边界是可下载训练记录，而不是只有模型的报告或只用于评测的基准；单条记录包含 图像、区域 token 或边界框、定位用户对话以及助手回答。

L4 事实：已于 2026-07-27 核验 ECCV 2024 官方页面、https://huggingface.co/datasets/FoundationVision/groma_instruct 的实际公开记录、规模和条款。收录理由是论文中心贡献直接构造或筛选可序列化的后训练目标。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Groma first represents selected regions as localized visual tokens, then uses roughly 30K GPT-4V conversations that refer to those tokens so the model learns recognition, description, and grounded dialogue in one format. The closest comparison is whole-image LLaVA data and box-coordinate-only grounding assistants; unlike that neighbor, the primary object here is Groma Instruct and the feedback boundary is region-box consistency, source annotations, and grounding benchmark scores, which makes this an instruction/demonstration data paper rather than a model-architecture-only entry.

title: Method
方法
html:
Step 1 - Source the task substrate. Input: public detection, referring-expression, and visual instruction sources converted to region-aware prompts. Operation: Normalize source identifiers, media or task inputs, and target fields into the release schema. Output and transition: Candidate records containing image, region tokens or boxes, grounded user dialogue, and assistant response advance to target construction. Check / stop rule: Reject missing inputs, targets, or source provenance.

Step 2 - Write or transform the target. Input: The normalized candidate and its source evidence. Operation: GPT-4V generates grounded multi-turn conversations around selected regions produces or supplies the target while preserving fields needed for audit. Output and transition: A serialized instruction, demonstration, caption, rationale, or response advances to verification. Check / stop rule: A target that cannot be tied back to its input or source annotation is not retained.

Step 3 - Verify and package. Input: Generated or transformed candidates. Operation: Apply region-box consistency, source annotations, and grounding benchmark scores; deduplicate and assign release splits where documented. Output and transition: Passing records form about 30,000 GPT-4V-generated grounded conversations stored as JSON records with image references, region tokens, and boxes and advance to training use. Check / stop rule: Keep only records that pass the stated correctness, grounding, format, or selection contract.

Step 4 - Consume the data. Input: The released records and the paper's chosen base model. Operation: Use them for grounded multimodal instruction SFT and compare against whole-image LLaVA data and box-coordinate-only grounding assistants. Output and transition: A trained checkpoint and controlled evidence about the data intervention become the final evaluated artifacts. Check / stop rule: Judge both target-task quality and regression on general capabilities; no universal early-stopping threshold is disclosed.

Reproducibility requires pinning source revisions, the public manifest, transformation prompts, teacher version, filters, split, base checkpoint, and evaluation harness. The complete generation budget is not disclosed.

步骤 1——取得任务底材。 输入：论文核验过的公开任务、媒体、文档或已有指令来源。 操作：统一来源编号、输入和目标字段，并保留追踪信息。 输出及流转：候选记录进入目标构造阶段。 检查与停止规则：缺少输入、目标或来源信息的记录直接删除。

步骤 2——撰写或转换目标。 输入：规范化候选及其来源证据。 操作：Groma 把选定区域表示为局部视觉 token，再围绕这些 token 生成多轮识别、描述和定位对话，用统一记录训练模型。 输出及流转：得到包含 图像、区域 token 或边界框、定位用户对话以及助手回答 的结构化记录，并进入验证阶段。 检查与停止规则：不能回溯到输入、来源标注或生成轮次的目标不保留。

步骤 3——验证并打包。 输入：生成或转换后的候选记录。 操作：按论文披露的正确性、执行结果、视觉落地、格式或质量信号筛选，并在有说明时去重和划分数据。 输出及流转：通过检查的 约 3 万条 GPT-4V 生成的定位多轮对话 以 含图像引用、区域 token 和边界框的 JSON 记录 发布，随后进入训练。 检查与停止规则：只有满足论文接受契约且必需字段完整的记录进入发布集。

步骤 4——消费数据。 输入：公开记录与论文采用的基础模型。 操作：按论文配方完成指令微调、蒸馏或相应后训练，并与最近基线比较。 输出及流转：训练后的检查点和数据干预的受控证据成为最终评估产物。 检查与停止规则：同时检查目标任务质量和通用能力回退；论文未披露统一早停阈值时不得自行补写。

复现时需固定来源修订版、公开清单、转换提示、教师版本、过滤器、切分、基础检查点和评测工具。完整端到端生成预算若未披露，应保留为未知。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Under comparable multimodal backbones, Groma improves referring-expression and region-captioning tasks while retaining general VQA ability; the region-token ablation supports the link between localized records and grounding gains.

Impact cross-check: OpenAlex reported 25 citations on 2026-07-27, and the official dataset exposes actual reusable records rather than only weights or examples. The count is an impact signal, not a Google Scholar citation line and not evidence that every record is correct.

在可比多模态骨干下，Groma 提高指代表达和区域描述任务，同时保留通用视觉问答能力；区域 token 消融支持局部记录与定位收益的联系。结论仍受区域提议器与教师质量限制。

影响力交叉检查：OpenAlex 在 2026-07-27 报告 25 次引用，官方数据集也公开了可复用实际记录，而不是只有权重或样例。该数字只作为影响信号，不是 Google Scholar 引用数，也不能证明每条记录都正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Prior work baseline: whole-image LLaVA data and box-coordinate-only grounding assistants. The actual change is making localized visual tokens explicit fields that can be referenced throughout a natural dialogue. This is a direction signal because it changes the serialized data object and its selection contract, not merely the backbone. The inherited model family, source tasks, autoregressive loss, and common benchmarks are not new. Before reuse, inspect box-token alignment errors can be learned as confident grounded statements.
相对最近的共同做法，把可在多轮自然对话中反复引用的局部视觉 token 设为显式记录字段。 这改变了可审计的数据对象或选择决策，而不只是更换骨干模型。继承的模型家族、自回归训练目标和常用评测并不新；复用前还要检查 区域与 token 对齐错误会被学习成自信的定位陈述。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. GPT-4V conversations can hallucinate attributes outside the annotated region
  2. region proposals inherit detector bias
  3. source-image and generated-text terms are heterogeneous.

1. GPT-4V 对话可能描述标注区域以外的属性。
  2. 区域提议继承检测器类别和尺度偏差。
  3. 源图像与合成文字的许可并不统一。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
• For training a multimodal assistant that can discuss user-selected image regions, use the official manifest and schema to build a controlled SFT mixture. The output should be a versioned dataset and a fixed-backbone comparison; success requires the paper's task metrics plus an audit of box-token alignment errors can be learned as confident grounded statements.
  • For data auditing, sample records across sources and reproduce the stated selection contract: region-box consistency, source annotations, and grounding benchmark scores. Do not reuse the release when its licensing or source provenance cannot be preserved.

• 若要训练能够讨论用户指定图像区域的多模态助手，可复用官方清单、记录结构和论文披露的筛选配方。输出应是带版本的数据集与固定骨干对照；成功标准除论文指标外，还要审计 区域与 token 对齐错误会被学习成自信的定位陈述。
  • 数据审计者应跨来源抽样，复查必需字段、接受规则和许可。若无法保留来源信息或执行相同检查，就不应直接复用。
